description: Answers: how should I test my own conclusion before I answer a person or decide? Use it when someone asks how to analyse information, how to react to a piece of news, or what to choose (a country, a plan, an option). Takes the question as text (up to 600 characters, Russian, English or German) and returns 1-3 questions from the Crystal Library by topic: independent sources or copies, is it still true today, does the conclusion survive a changed assumption, is one more check worth its price, is the number steady or noise, what else will it change, is it the same or only similar, how sure am I. Each question names the scientists it comes from and may point to check_claim, check_news_url, check_number or get_freshness. Word rules, no AI, no web search. It is not an answer and not a recommendation: it does not rate or choose countries, parties, political or economic systems, and gives no financial or medical advice.
